name: 77093 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77093 (Houston) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77093 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 30 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77093 (Houston) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
